nodes.label: method/ — the store of record
nodes.rationale: Both live bundles and all 765 byte-exact members; verify.py asserts every member md5 and recovers both bundles. The live pair is named in method/CLAUDE.md section 3 and nowhere else, so a build moves one sentence rather than several.

nodes.label: drive/ — the read-only mirror
nodes.rationale: 819 files, ~842 MB, mirrored from two Google Drive folders. It is the archive and original-input witness, not the read path, and is never written to by the extraction or recovery passes.

nodes.label: Manifest/tree bijection
nodes.rationale: MANIFEST.tsv and the tree are an exact bijection across the two mirrored root folders only; drive/chats/ holds 354 files with no row because it is the sharded chat export, and --prune walks only the mirrored roots.

nodes.label: extracted/ — the generated tree
nodes.rationale: 779 distinct bodies written once from 2,504 sealed file occurrences in 31 archives and 9 project exports; regenerate, never hand-edit.

nodes.label: recovered/ — what the chat export wrote
nodes.rationale: 3,173 files over 3,224 ledger rows in six statuses; how a file was found is part of what it is, so a status is never flattened.

nodes.label: The chat-67 full hold
nodes.rationale: A finding is recorded, never repaired. It governs every audit report exactly as it governs a section read.

nodes.label: A status is never flattened
nodes.rationale: RECOVERED, RECOVERED-BY-WRITE, RECOVERED-BY-HEADING, RECOVERED-BY-NUMBER, RECOVERED-TRUNCATED, PINNED, ADOPTED, RECONSTRUCTED: each records how a thing is known, and collapsing them destroys the distinction the corpus is built to keep.

nodes.label: Twenty-three seated members need Python 3.12
nodes.rationale: PEP 701: a backslash inside an f-string expression is a SyntaxError before 3.12 and legal from it. They are not corrupt; the paragraph said ten until docfigures.py measured otherwise.

nodes.label: method/bin on PATH, not typing python3.12
nodes.rationale: gate.py runs every instrument as python3 NAME.py, hard-coded, so the interpreter must be python3; without the PATH prefix four live goldens read FAIL and close_rebank.py would bank the traceback as the golden.

nodes.label: Six .py files parse under no interpreter
nodes.rationale: All six are recovered or extracted chat fragments rather than members; a fragment is what RECOVERED means when a chat showed only part of a file, so parse before trusting a recovered .py.

nodes.label: A document corpus, not a software project
nodes.rationale: No build, no linter, no package manager; do not offer CI and do not try to set the project up. The .py files under drive/ are mirrored artifacts.

nodes.label: Do not scan the tree wholesale
nodes.rationale: Start from MANIFEST.tsv or extracted/LEDGER.tsv and run targeted ls/grep; the tree holds 14 MB tarballs, 11 MB CSVs and ~6 MB build Markdown.

nodes.label: The __<driveFileId> suffix
nodes.rationale: 99 files marked as an older Drive copy of a duplicated title; the newest copy keeps the plain name. Both are intentional and neither is merged or deleted.

nodes.label: The BUILD series naming convention
nodes.rationale: The_Method_1_6_BUILD<N>_*.md in two streams, BUILD9 to BUILD179, 140 files including five variant copies; the series has gaps, so the first archived build carrying a figure is not the build that introduced it.

nodes.label: An instrument imports a seated member, never copies one
nodes.rationale: populate.py loads LW1-ground.py and tower-2.py by path and imports the order operator from cypher.py rather than reimplementing it; where a needed form is unstated the value carries RECOVERED or RECONSTRUCTED.

nodes.label: tools/ copies drift ahead of their seated members
nodes.rationale: Thirty-one tools/ programs are also members; the member is the snapshot at its seating build. Five are ahead right now, and nothing in the store reported it until docfigures.py carried the row. A nonzero count is not a fault, it is the list of seatings owed.

nodes.label: Each audit instrument's selftest fixtures are the corpus's own recorded numbers
nodes.rationale: Stdlib-only, run before trusting a report; each instrument refuses to report certain things and the refusals are the point. NOT-BOUND, AMBIGUOUS and ABSENT are not findings and may not be quoted as ones.

nodes.label: The five operator-bearing languages, measured
nodes.rationale: Order, algebra, geometry, information and statistics on Lambda, C(5,2)=10 with all ten agreeing: register 1173's count with a different membership, since statistics returns a binary and analysis does not.

nodes.label: graphify-out/ is a snapshot, not an index
nodes.rationale: 26,364 nodes and 36,150 edges in 2,929 communities, rebuilt 2026-09-04 over 4,090 files at 3.45M subagent tokens; a miss in the graph is not evidence a file is absent.

nodes.label: Do not run /graphify --update here
nodes.rationale: build_merge runs a repository-wide dedup as a side effect and would drop 353 nodes from unchanged files, 121 of them folding one tree into another; currency costs a full rebuild instead.

nodes.label: 8,908 dangling-endpoint edges, and the split is the point
nodes.rationale: 8,881 are AST imports to stdlib modules that are not files here; 27 come from the semantic layer and are cross-chunk id coordination — real concepts, dangling references.

nodes.label: Only 44 of 2,929 community labels are hand-written
nodes.rationale: The other 2,885 are derived from each community's dominant source file, which is a naming convenience and not a reading of the community.

nodes.label: The R2-R4 build machinery
nodes.rationale: Twelve tools/ programs in four groups: the build and the gate (close_main, close_vol, restage, gate_live), keeping a count honest (register_counts), triaging a moved golden (shiftinv, shiftcheck, shiftcheck2), and re-anchoring a successor (reanchor, proveanchor), plus two audits.

nodes.label: close_vol.py — the fourth close route
nodes.rationale: Built because no tool could write a compendium repair: close.py refuses any change to a seated member, close_main.py writes only the Register, close_rebank.py only a golden. Every substitution carries its own occurrence count and the reverse guard must reproduce the old bundle's md5.

nodes.label: Use graphify only when the user types /graphify
nodes.rationale: Its own description invites treating any corpus question as a graph query; an ordinary question about a file is answered from MANIFEST.tsv and a targeted grep, never by building a graph over 508 MB.

hyperedges.label: The stdlib-only audit instruments whose selftest fixtures are the corpus's own numbers
The four trees and the provenance discipline that keeps them distinct
